panel_scope: preregistered development transfer; not primary outcomes or final native-pack execution times

methods.source: to be frozen under independent/acquisition before any panel outcome

source_freeze_rule: all executable source and adapter hashes frozen before any panel solve is called; no source edits in response to panel outcomes
same_input_rule: each method receives exactly the same generated forward and inverse task/template; design is separately materialized from that method actual accepted inverse result, with no truth substitution
acceptance_rule: workloads/verifier.py verify with exact public TOLERANCES unchanged; connected design receives actual parent task and result
failures_rule: preserve every attempt, exception, incomplete result, blocked downstream stage, full numerical arrays, and verification report
timing_rule: time.perf_counter around solve(task) numerical method call, with task generation, file IO, and independent verification recorded separately; single-thread BLAS environment and threadpool limit used identically; one first invocation per method and stage only
acquisition_interval_rule: wall clock from first authorized shared-source discovery through adapter source freeze; separate from original independent construction and panel execution
time_interpretation: observed elapsed wall time; not active human attention, model token cost, inference billing, or monetary bill
root_contribution_rule: portable manifest references immutable independent/solver.py design dispatcher without duplicate copied implementation assets
excluded_sources: all sealed seed or answer files
